pity.en: She felt pity for the injured bird and called a wildlife center.
pity.zh: 她很同情那隻受傷的鳥，於是聯絡野生動物中心。

plain.en: The teacher used plain language to explain the difficult scientific idea.
plain.zh: 老師用淺白的語言解釋這個困難的科學概念。

plane.en: Our plane landed safely after a short delay caused by weather.
plane.zh: 班機因天候短暫延誤後安全降落。

planet.en: Scientists continue searching for a planet with conditions similar to Earth.
planet.zh: 科學家持續尋找條件與地球相似的行星。

plantation.en: The history exhibit describes life on a tea plantation many decades ago.
plantation.zh: 歷史展覽描述數十年前茶園裡的生活。

platform.en: The school launched an online platform for sharing homework and announcements.
platform.zh: 學校推出線上平台，用來分享作業與公告。

playful.en: The playful puppy chased fallen leaves across the quiet yard.
playful.zh: 那隻愛玩的小狗在安靜院子裡追著落葉跑。

playground.en: Students gathered at the playground during the afternoon break.
playground.zh: 學生在下午休息時間聚集在操場。

playwright.en: The young playwright wrote a comedy for the school drama club.
playwright.zh: 那位年輕劇作家為學校戲劇社寫了一齣喜劇。

plea.en: The community group made a plea for more trees in the neighborhood.
plea.zh: 社區團體呼籲在附近種植更多樹木。

plead.en: The students plead for extra practice time before the final performance.
plead.zh: 學生懇求在正式演出前多一些練習時間。

pleasant.en: A pleasant breeze made the outdoor reading session more comfortable.
pleasant.zh: 宜人的微風讓戶外閱讀時間更加舒適。

pleasure.en: It was a pleasure to work with classmates who shared ideas openly.
pleasure.zh: 能和願意公開分享想法的同學合作是一件愉快的事。

pledge.en: The club made a pledge to reduce disposable waste at school events.
pledge.zh: 社團承諾在校內活動中減少一次性垃圾。

plentiful.en: Fresh water is plentiful in the region during the rainy season.
plentiful.zh: 雨季期間，這個地區的淡水資源十分充足。

plenty.en: There is plenty of time to revise the report before Friday.
plenty.zh: 星期五前還有充足時間修改報告。

plot.en: The novel has a complex plot involving several families and generations.
plot.zh: 這本小說有一個涉及多個家庭與世代的複雜情節。

plow.en: Farmers plow the field before planting the next season's crops.
plow.zh: 農民在種植下一季作物前先犁田。

plug.en: Please plug the projector into the outlet before the presentation begins.
plug.zh: 簡報開始前請先把投影機插上插座。

plum.en: She packed a ripe plum with her lunch for school.
plum.zh: 她在學校午餐中帶了一顆熟李子。

plumber.en: A plumber repaired the leaking pipe beneath the kitchen sink.
plumber.zh: 水電工修好了廚房水槽下方漏水的管線。

plunge.en: Temperatures may plunge after the cold front reaches the island tonight.
plunge.zh: 今晚冷鋒抵達後，氣溫可能會大幅下降。

plural.en: The teacher explained when this noun needs a plural form.
plural.zh: 老師說明這個名詞何時需要使用複數形式。

plus.en: The course includes weekly practice plus two review sessions before exams.
plus.zh: 這門課包含每週練習，另外還有兩次考前複習。

pocket.en: He found the missing ticket inside his jacket pocket.
pocket.zh: 他在外套口袋裡找到遺失的票。

poem.en: Each student chose a short poem to read aloud in class.
poem.zh: 每位學生選了一首短詩在課堂上朗讀。

poet.en: The poet often wrote about rivers, seasons, and ordinary village life.
poet.zh: 那位詩人常描寫河流、季節與平凡的鄉村生活。

poetic.en: The writer uses poetic language to describe the quiet winter landscape.
poetic.zh: 作者用富有詩意的文字描寫寧靜的冬日景色。

poetry.en: Reading poetry helped her notice rhythm and imagery in language.
poetry.zh: 閱讀詩歌讓她更能注意語言中的節奏與意象。

poke.en: He used a pencil to poke a small hole in the paper model.
poke.zh: 他用鉛筆在紙模型上戳了一個小洞。

polar.en: The documentary examines how polar ecosystems respond to changing temperatures.
polar.zh: 紀錄片探討極地生態系如何因應溫度變化。

pole.en: A small flag was attached to the top of the pole.
pole.zh: 一面小旗子被固定在桿子的頂端。

polish.en: She used a soft cloth to polish the old wooden table.
polish.zh: 她用柔軟的布擦亮那張舊木桌。

polite.en: It is polite to listen carefully when another person is speaking.
polite.zh: 別人說話時仔細聆聽是一種有禮貌的表現。

pollute.en: Plastic waste can pollute rivers and harm nearby wildlife habitats.
pollute.zh: 塑膠垃圾可能污染河川並傷害附近野生動物棲地。

pollution.en: The city introduced new buses to reduce air pollution downtown.
pollution.zh: 市府引進新公車以減少市中心的空氣污染。

pond.en: Several frogs appeared beside the pond after the evening rain.
pond.zh: 晚間下雨後，池塘旁出現了幾隻青蛙。

ponder.en: She paused to ponder the question before giving her final answer.
ponder.zh: 她停了一下思考問題，才給出最後答案。

pony.en: The children watched a pony graze quietly behind the fence.
pony.zh: 孩子們看著一匹小馬在圍欄後安靜吃草。

pool.en: The community pool closes early on days with severe weather.
pool.zh: 遇到惡劣天候時，社區游泳池會提早關閉。

poor.en: Poor lighting made the small print difficult to read clearly.
poor.zh: 光線不足讓小字很難看清楚。

pop.en: The balloon may pop if too much air is added.
pop.zh: 如果充入太多空氣，氣球可能會爆掉。

popcorn.en: We shared a bowl of popcorn while watching the school film.
popcorn.zh: 我們看校內影片時一起分享了一碗爆米花。

popularity.en: The app gained popularity because its design was simple and useful.
popularity.zh: 這個應用程式因設計簡單實用而變得受歡迎。

populate.en: Many small fish populate the shallow waters near the reef.
populate.zh: 許多小魚棲息在珊瑚礁附近的淺水區。

porcelain.en: The museum displayed a porcelain bowl decorated with blue patterns.
porcelain.zh: 博物館展示一只有藍色花紋的瓷碗。

porch.en: They left their muddy shoes on the porch before entering.
porch.zh: 他們進屋前把沾泥的鞋留在門廊。

pork.en: The menu clearly marks which dishes contain pork or seafood.
pork.zh: 菜單清楚標示哪些餐點含有豬肉或海鮮。

port.en: The cargo ship arrived at the port shortly after sunrise.
port.zh: 貨輪在日出後不久抵達港口。

portable.en: The class used a portable speaker during the outdoor presentation.
portable.zh: 班上在戶外報告時使用可攜式喇叭。
